title: Chat to Advancement
description: When someone unlocks an advancement, clicking the advancement title in the chat bar will jump to the corresponding advancement page.
body:
# Chat to Advancement
<details>
<summary>中文页面</summary>

# 简介
当某人解锁一个进度时，点击聊天栏的进度标题就可以跳转至对应的进度页面

# 兼容性
- Advancements Reloaded √

其余进度页面优化模组的兼容性未知，将逐步适配中。

# 如何正确安装？
- 将此模组包移至游戏实例的`mods`目录下即可完成部署，无需前置模组。  
- 需要服务端和客户端同时部署才能实现此模组的全部功能。

</details>


<details>
<summary>English Page</summary>

# Introduction

When someone unlocks an advancement, clicking the advancement title in the chat bar will jump to the corresponding advancement page.

# Compatibility

- Advancements Reloaded √

Compatibility with other advancement page optimization mods is currently unknown and will be adapted gradually.

# How to Install It Correctly?

- Move this mod package into the `mods` directory of the game instance to complete the installation. No prerequisite mods are required.
- This mod must be installed on both the server and the client to enable all of its features.

</details>
